# 💫 About Me
Embedded Software Engineer with a strong focus on hardware-software co-design, developing reliable firmware, and low-level systems programming. 
Core focus: bare-metal peripheral control, RTOS-based multithreading, Linux kernel modules, custom memory management, and network protocols.
I bridge the gap between hardware and software: from register-level control and linker scripts to production-ready firmware architecture and system optimization.

### What I work with
- **Microcontrollers & Bare-Metal:** ARM Cortex-M, ESP32 series, CMSIS register-level programming
- **RTOS & Multithreading:** FreeRTOS synchronization (mutexes, semaphores), task priorities, queues, and multi-core processing (ESP-IDF)
- **Systems Programming & Networking:** Linux Kernel Modules, custom memory allocators (Buddy-style optimization), LwIP stack, network sockets
- **Hardware Interfaces:** UART/USART, SPI, I2C and hardware-level debugging
- **Primary Languages:** C, Assembly (x86/FASM) | English(B1), Russian(native)
- **Secondary Languages:** Kotlin, Python, SystemVerilog, Bash
